reasons: The selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge", but tup_fetched is defined as type sum (monotonic) and the dataset only has dataset_types sum, so the selector matches no series. It should be otel_metric_type="sum".
The rate() over a monotonic sum is the right choice, and the rate yields per-second values matching the widget's per-sec title.
The avg() over all series matches the Datadog avg aggregation with the {$scope} template variable dropped (no prefix, default *), and there is no grouping on either side.
The metric mapping (postgresql.rows_fetched to postgresql.tup_fetched) measures the same quantity, so the outcome of translated is correct.
